name: Dew Drop Gel Cleanser
short: A light gel that lifts away oil and sunscreen without leaving skin tight.
description: A pH-balanced gel cleanser that foams softly to remove makeup, sweat and excess sebum. Skin feels clean, fresh and comfortable, never stripped.
howToUse: Massage onto damp skin for 60 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water. Use morning and evening.

name: Oat Milk Cream Cleanser
short: A creamy, soothing wash that cleanses while leaving a soft moisture veil.
description: Colloidal oat and squalane cleanse gently and calm redness. A comforting first step for dry or reactive skin.
howToUse: Apply to dry or damp skin, massage in circles, then rinse or wipe off with a soft cloth.

name: Rose Water Balancing Toner
short: An alcohol-free toner that refreshes and preps skin for serums.
description: Damask rose water and hyaluronic acid hydrate and rebalance skin after cleansing. Layer it for extra glow.
howToUse: Pat onto clean skin with hands or a cotton pad. Follow with serum and moisturizer.

name: Vitamin C Brightening Serum
short: 15% stabilized vitamin C to brighten dark spots and boost radiance.
description: A lightweight antioxidant serum that visibly fades uneven tone and protects against daily environmental stress.
howToUse: Apply 3-4 drops to clean skin in the morning, then finish with moisturizer and SPF.

name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydration Serum
short: Three weights of hyaluronic acid for deep, plump, lasting hydration.
description: Multi-molecular hyaluronic acid draws water into every layer of skin for a bouncy, dewy finish without stickiness.
howToUse: Apply to damp skin morning and night, then seal with a moisturizer.

name: Niacinamide 10% Clarifying Serum
short: Minimizes the look of pores and balances shine and blemishes.
description: 10% niacinamide with zinc helps regulate oil, refine texture and fade post-blemish marks over time.
howToUse: Apply a few drops to the whole face morning or night, before moisturizer.

name: Ceramide Barrier Moisturizer
short: A rich cushiony cream that repairs and protects the skin barrier.
description: Three essential ceramides plus cholesterol and fatty acids rebuild the barrier and lock in moisture for 48 hours.
howToUse: Smooth over face and neck as the last step of your routine, morning and night.

name: Green Tea Water Gel Cream
short: An oil-free, bouncy gel that hydrates and soothes without heaviness.
description: Antioxidant-rich green tea and aloe deliver weightless moisture, ideal for humid weather and oily skin.
howToUse: Apply an almond-sized amount to face and neck after serum.

name: Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50
short: Broad-spectrum zinc oxide protection with no white cast.
description: A sheer, fragrance-free mineral SPF 50 PA++++ that wears comfortably under makeup and is reef-friendly.
howToUse: Apply generously as the final morning step and reapply every 2 hours in direct sun.

name: Overnight Retinol Night Cream
short: Encapsulated retinol that smooths fine lines while you sleep.
description: Time-released 0.3% retinol with peptides and ceramides refines texture and firmness with minimal irritation.
howToUse: Use 2-3 nights a week at first, then increase gradually. Always wear SPF the next day.
